fails_if: the deferred partition compile keeps an unselected register's unmatched split pins as declared names (for example as naming-ambiguity entries, as `_partition_ambiguity` did before it split them off), so the slice defers the edge to scb/sample/other as a warning and completes

sources.description: Step 1's delivery (variable 5 of register 1 delivers Kon in 2020, KON and LEFT in 2021) plus register 2 (OTHERREG, variant 20), whose variable 201 delivers OTHER.

note: Step 9's slice with the edge to scb/sample/other, the pin step 1 reports stale. The deferred partition compile discards an unselected register's unmatched splits (`_unmatched`), so the pin declares nothing: the slice cannot prove the target exists and keeps the complete build's missing-dependency refusal (reg_meta_build/DESIGN.md, register-scoped builds: a target no scope declares stays the complete build's error).
